There is no discount line and no rounding line; the customer total is rounded to 2 decimals, the tax is kept with 7 decimals (0.15 x 343.81685 exactly) and the revenue is the remainder (395.39 - 51.5725275).

The printed invoice (preview iframe) shows الإجمالي-before-discount المجموع 355.55, الخصم -11.73, القيمة المضافة (15%) 51.57, الإجمالي 395.39, تاريخ الفاتورة 25/10/2026 and «تاريخ الاستحقاق 26/10/2026» (date + شروط الدفع 1 day); the form total shown before saving was identical (الخصم (3.3%) -11.73, VAT 51.57, الإجمالي 395.39).

The edit form of the issued invoice (/owner/invoices/edit/36, GET only) stores the document discount as typed (data[Invoice][discount] = 3.3, disabled) and every line field disabled (unit_price, quantity, discount_type, tax1); the fields NOT disabled after issue include data[Invoice][due_after] (1), sales_person_id, store_id and each line store_id.

Invoice A (lines: stock item 3 x 100.00 with line discount 10 % = 270.00, VAT 15 %; free text 2 x 33.33 = 66.66, VAT 15 %; free text 1 x 55.55 = 55.55, no tax; fixed invoice discount 20 typed as «المبلغ»; date and issue date 20/10/2026) saved: number 000029 (view/37), status «غير مدفوعة» and «سٌلم», message «تم حفظ الفاتورة, إضافة جديدة», journal links «قيد 000139#» and «تكلفة مبيعات #000140».

There is ONE 411 line and ONE 215001 line for the three lines, no discount line, no rounding line. The tax equals exactly 0.15 x (336.66 x (1 - 20/392.21)) = 47.92389992606: the fixed discount is converted to the percent 20 / 392.21 (392.21 = sum of the lines after line discounts, taxed or not) kept UNROUNDED, applied to every line, tax computed on the discounted taxed lines only and stored with about 11 decimals; the total 420.13 is rounded to cents and the revenue is the remainder.

«مستحقة الدفع» is every invoice with an open balance (all three D1 invoices), while «متأخر» is the open invoices whose due date is before today: after editing شروط الدفع of #000028 from 1 to 2 days (due 27/10/2026 = today) it LEFT «متأخر» and stayed in «مستحقة الدفع» (printed «تاريخ الاستحقاق 27/10/2026»); after editing it to 30 days (due 24/11/2026) it is still outside «متأخر». So an invoice due today is not overdue; overdue means due date strictly before today (observed boundary: due 26/10 overdue on 27/10, due 27/10 not).

An invoice saved with NO payment term (شروط الدفع empty, stored due_after 0), date 20/10/2026 and an open balance (#000029) appears in «متأخر» on 27/10/2026 and its printed invoice has no «تاريخ الاستحقاق» line; consistent with due date = invoice date when no term is set (the rule is read from the list, the stored due date of such an invoice is not displayed).
